```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
ReportConcreteCase <- function(liningID, caseID) {
  Data <- if (identical(liningID, "shotcrete")) {
    Calculation$shotcrete$summary
  } else if (identical(liningID, "reinforcedConcrete")) {
    Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$summary
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported concrete lining: ", liningID)
  }
  Row <- Data[Data$caseID == caseID, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(Row) != 1L) {
    stop("Missing concrete result: ", liningID, ".", caseID)
  }
  Row
}
PlainPass <- all(c(
  ReportConcreteCase("shotcrete", "alpha-1")$shotcreteLocalStrengthStatus,
  ReportConcreteCase("shotcrete", "alpha-0")$shotcreteLocalStrengthStatus
) == "satisfied")
ReinforcedConcreteStrength <- Calculation$config$additionalLinings$
  reinforcedConcrete$compressiveStrengthMPa
ReinforcedBeta1 <- calculateAci31825Beta1(ReinforcedConcreteStrength)
ReinforcedGradeLabel <- gsub(
  "-",
  " ",
  Calculation$config$additionalLinings$reinforcedConcrete$
    reinforcementGradeID,
  fixed = TRUE
)
ReinforcedSteel <- unique(
  Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$reinforcement[
    c("yieldStrengthMPa", "modulusMPa")
  ]
)
if (nrow(ReinforcedSteel) != 1L) {
  stop("The reinforced-concrete layers must use one steel grade.")
}
StrengthCases <- Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$strengthCases
FormatStrengthFactor <- function(value) {
  gsub(".", ",", formatCalculationGeneral(value), fixed = TRUE)
}
StrengthCasePairs <- paste0(
  "EV ×",
  vapply(
    StrengthCases$verticalStressFactor,
    FormatStrengthFactor,
    character(1)
  ),
  " y EH ×",
  vapply(
    StrengthCases$horizontalStressFactor,
    FormatStrengthFactor,
    character(1)
  )
)
StrengthCaseSentence <- if (length(StrengthCasePairs) == 1L) {
  StrengthCasePairs
} else {
  paste(
    paste(StrengthCasePairs[-length(StrengthCasePairs)], collapse = ", "),
    StrengthCasePairs[length(StrengthCasePairs)],
    sep = " y "
  )
}
ReinforcementStudy <- Calculation$config$additionalLinings$
  reinforcedConcrete$reinforcementStudy
```
